dct_description_sm: The ‘Land use allocation to Soils and Landforms by year’ dataset links agricultural land use activities to soils and landscapes within Soil Landscapes of Canada (SLC) polygons.  The land use allocations to soils area datasets were generated on an annual time step (1971-2015).  Agricultural land use is categorized and allocated based on the following general land use types: Annual cropland, Perennial cropland, Specialty Crops, Improved pasture and Unimproved Pasture.
dct_title_s: Land Use Allocation to Soil and Landforms by Year
